_comment: F3 self-refresh: the loader atomically replaces this WHOLE file with the own-repo copy when that copy's last_verified is strictly newer (bounded to today+1d). Manual local edits MUST bump last_verified — a newer repo copy overwrites uncommitted local edits by design. A SoT row wins over the litellm overlay permanently, so two rows that deliberately break their family prefix are pinned here and only an operator edit can move them: claude-fable-5-1 at cache_read 0.25 against the claude-fable-5 family 1.0, and claude-opus-5-5 at 4.0/20.0/0.2/5.0 against the claude-opus-5 family 5.0/25.0/0.5/6.25 (a missing row resolves either id to its family prefix). A row also flips its id unknown->is_known, so backfill-cost-events.py --reprice rewrites stored core.cost_events rows for it at this rate retroactively (calc_cost keys on each row's event_date and neither row declares tiers); the last_verified bump re-stamps the WHOLE file, suppressing cost-tracker.sh's stale advisory for every row until 2026-12-22 (stale_after_days 90) though only one row was touched.
